Timers

Live countdowns for every recurring AION 2 event: Spacetime Rift, Shugo Festival, Artifact Siege, Siege Bosses, Guardian General Nahma, Watcher Kaira and the daily and weekly resets, for the Global, Korea and Taiwan servers, in your local time.

NA East — server time America/New_York

NA East servers run on New York time, and every event below follows that clock (the local hour stays the same when the clocks go back on November 1). Daily and weekly resets happen at one moment on every Global server, 16:00 Korean time (07:00 UTC): 03:00 New York time, 02:00 from November 1. NCSOFT has not published the Global event times; if one is off on your server, tell us on Discord.

EventSchedule (server time)DurationWhat it is
🌀 Spacetime RiftDaily · 02:00, 05:00, 08:00, 11:00, 14:00, 17:00, 20:00, 23:0060 min (portal 10 min)The portal only stays open for the first 10 minutes; once inside the event runs for a full hour: cross-faction PvP, Sealed Dungeons, special quests and Abyss Points.
🎪 Shugo FestivalEvery hour at :0010 min4-9 player minigames every hour on the hour, 10 minutes long: one random game from the pool (Jump Jump, Nyerk Shooter, Hidden Lugi, Goldrin's Treasure…). Rewards include gear, Abyss Points, Wisdom Stones and Daevanion Crystals.
🛡️ Dimensional InvasionEvery hour at :3015 minField defense event every hour at :30.
🏰 Artifact SiegeMon, Thu, Sat · 21:0030 minLower and Middle Abyss artifact battle; the winning faction gains access to the Abyss Corridor. Since the September 30 Korea patch the Dimensional Core gets the Decline of Power debuff after 8 minutes.
👹 Siege BossesMon, Thu, Sat · 21:3030 minRight after the Artifact Siege, in the Lower Abyss: Executor Tamasa, Executor Argo and Executor Kaira.
🐉 Guardian Lord NahmaFri, Sun · 21:0030 minGuardian Lord Nahma and Enraged Guardian Lord Nahma spawn in the Abyss.
👁️ Watcher KairaDaily · 01:00, 04:00, 07:00, 10:00, 13:00, 16:00, 19:00, 22:0030 minLower Abyss field boss that appears at a random spot on a fixed cycle (every 4 hours on Korea and Taiwan, every 3 hours on Global) and leaves 30 minutes later.
🔄 Daily resetDaily · 16:00 KST—Daily quests, dungeon entries, Transcendence charges and Shugo Festival keys refresh.
📅 Weekly resetWed · 16:00 KST—Weekly activities and raids refresh together with the daily reset of that day (Wednesday).

NA West — server time America/Los_Angeles

NA West servers run on Los Angeles (Pacific) time, and every event below follows that clock (the local hour stays the same when the clocks go back on November 1). Daily and weekly resets happen at one moment on every Global server, 16:00 Korean time (07:00 UTC): 00:00 Los Angeles time, then 23:00 the evening before from November 1 (the weekly reset falls on Tuesday night). NCSOFT has not published the Global event times; if one is off on your server, tell us on Discord.
